description_en: Long-wear foundation for a natural, super-luminous look with a silky texture. Medium-to-high coverage with ultra-fine silicone oils evens skin tone for flawless, radiant skin all day (pack: lightweight, paraben free, vegan friendly).

Line 211 is a separate code with the same POS name. It most likely matches the newer 'PRO AIRLESS' 30ml repackaging (SKU R-27AIR, grigi.gr product id 3166), but no retailer lists 5207042211271 directly. Shade 27 = Natural on both versions.

line_en: GRIGI Pro Airless Optimum Primer Pro 30ml
description_en: Silky make-up base of water and elastomer silicone oils. It smooths the skin and fills fine lines and imperfections for a long-wear, silk-and-matte finish (pack: fresh touch, paraben free, oil free, vegan friendly).
evidence: Line 230 = original primers: 5207042230012 = Pro Optimum Primer (beautyfree.gr and epharmadora; froufrouaromata lists 230029 for it instead), 5207042230036 = Pro Luminous Primer 3 in 1. Line 231 is new; 01/02 match the airless SKUs 01AIR (Optimum) and 02AIR (Perfect). Retail prices fit too: Airless Optimum is EUR 14.90 (beautyyou.gr) and Airless Perfect EUR 19.90 (grigi.gr), against POS IQD 30000 and 33000. The official media file _-01air.jpg is the airless 'OPTIMUM PRIMER PRO' bottle. No grigi.gr page is live for the airless Optimum, and no retailer lists this EAN.

line_en: GRIGI Pro Airless Perfect Primer Pro 30ml
description_en: PRO PERFECT PRIMER with elastomer silicone oils. It spreads easily, instantly smoothing the skin and filling wrinkles and imperfections, with a matte finish (pack: high coverage, paraben/talc/perfume free, vegan friendly).
evidence: See 5207042231019. Official SKU 02AIR (grigi.gr product id 3119) matches line 231, position 02. Not confirmed by any EAN listing.

line_en: GRIGI Perfect Fixer Make Up Pro 50ml
description_en: Alcohol-free make-up setting spray that forms an invisible protective film, keeping make-up unchanged for up to 12 hours and shielding the skin from heat, humidity, sweat and pollution. Can also be misted during the day to refresh make-up.
evidence: beautyfree.gr 'GRIGI Perfect Fixer Make Up Pro 50ml' shows code 5207042370015. epharmadora 'Grigi Perfect Fixer Make-Up Pro' has barcode 5207042370015 (https://epharmadora.com/vendors/grigi/grigi-perfect-fixer-makeup-pro.htm). Sibling 370022 = Glow Fixer. It is the regular, not a 'matte', fixer. The official page grigi-perfect-fixer-make-up-pro-01 now returns 404. The official packshot gpfp-01.jpg reads 'PERFECT FIXER MAKE UP PRO'.

line_en: GRIGI On The Go Peptide Stick Blush

evidence: Line 770 = On The Go peptide stick blush (existing DB variants 770013/770037/770051 = 01/03/05). grigi.gr (product id 3165) lists 'GRIGI ON THE GO PEPTIDE STICK BLUSH No 06 BROWNY', colour attribute BROWNY. grigi.gr shade names: 02 Berry, 03 Warm Pink Coral, 05 Muted Brick, 06 Browny. line_en: GRIGI The Skin Perception (most likely Glow Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum 1%)
description_en: Water-based, richly textured serum with hyaluronic acid in several molecular weights for hydration and anti-ageing, plus 1% betaine to hydrate and reduce irritation. Absorbs quickly for brighter, healthier 'glass skin' (pack: paraben free, vegan).
evidence: No EAN listing found. 550011 = Skin Perception Perfector(Perfectioner) Face Oil Base 30ml (DB). The 550 line holds two other known 30ml-class face items: the Glow Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum 1% (grigi.gr SKU suffix -03, product id 3162; the page does not state volume) and the 'Moisturizing Argan & Cannabis Facial Oil 30ml' (skroutz listings). Position 03 matches the serum's SKU suffix, but SKU suffixes do not reliably match EAN positions (the Sleeping Mask 10ml is also '-01'). Check the physical pack before publishing.
